_comment: Kimi Code CLI：配置是 TOML（~/.kimi-code/config.toml 的 [[hooks]] 数组），不是 JSON；本文件仅为结构化占位，请按下述 toml 转写。官方文档 https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code/blob/main/docs/en/customization/hooks.md
_toml_template:
[[hooks]]
event = "SessionStart"
matcher = "startup|resume"
command = "PYTHON_EXECUTABLE HOOKS_DIR/kimi_adapter.py"
timeout = 10

[[hooks]]
event = "UserPromptSubmit"
command = "PYTHON_EXECUTABLE HOOKS_DIR/kimi_adapter.py"
timeout = 10
